english: Huh?
(That's Tsubasa.)
You're...?\nWell, whatever.
(Wh-what... has she forgotten me?)
Are you shopping, Tsubasa? Or out for a walk?
...Well, something like that.
(Huh, which is it?)
A little patrol.\nEven in town,\ndanger isn't out of the question.
Taking the lead sounds nice,\nbut that's all I can do.\nMy duty as a guardian — no, a warrior.
As expected...\nOh, right — thank you for the other day.
Wh-what are you talking about?
When I messed up in battle\nand you covered for me.
Ah...\nI feel like something like that happened.
That happens on the battlefield, don't worry about it.\nI won't either.
(Huh? She doesn't remember...?)
...Nice weather tonight.
Yes...\nOn a moonlit night like this,\nI find myself wanting to lose myself in thought, alone...
(C-come on, some conversation starter...)
You look sleepy.\nI don't think staying up late is good.\nI want you at your best for battle.
...\nIt seems you don't have any particular business.
I'm going to go swing my sword a bit.\nSomething of a habit\nwhen I'm troubled.
So, that's that.\nUntil...
S-she's so distant...\nHmm, does she hate me...?
We meet again.
Tsubasa, um...
What?
Did I do something rude to you, Tsubasa?\nIt feels like you're avoiding me...
Th-that's not true.
You are, after all, a comrade I fight beside.\nI'd never treat you coldly.
I must seem unreliable to you,\nbut if there's anything bad about me I'll fix it,\nso please don't hold back.
It's not that... the problem is me.
Th-that is...\nI'm not very good with people.
Really...?\nBut you're always briskly leading everyone.
That's me on the battlefield —\nKazanari Tsubasa the warrior.
In battle I'm fired up too.\nBut normally I'm clumsy...
I just can't navigate social stuff well.\nThat's why I'm often alone like this, right?
That's... surprising.\nI thought you were the beloved-by-all type...
Fufu... in reality it's the exact opposite.
So that's why you're always alone,\nwatching everyone.\nMakes sense now.
...\nHearing it said to my face stings a little.
Ah, I-I'm sorry!
Well...\nlet me tell you a little about myself.
Between my work with the Special Disaster Response Team Section Two\nand my job as a singer,\nI've only ever dealt with adults.
So I don't really know\nhow to act around kids my own age.\nIt always troubles me.
And having grown up at an all-girls school, with men it's especially...\nwell.
(Huh... Tsubasa has a cute side too.)
So a boy like you\nis harder for me to approach\nthan Noise.
Anyway, please understand —\nit's not that I dislike you.
...You look relieved.\nI'm sorry if I offended you.
Well then, I'll be going.\nTonight's moon is perfect\nfor a leisurely stroll, thinking of tomorrow.
So right now I'm on the same level as Noise...\nComplicated...
(Huh... I hear singing... that's Tsubasa.\nMaybe she's practicing?)
Who's there!!
Sorry, sorry, sorry
I'd sensed someone for a while —\nit was you.\nSorry to startle you.
I'm sorry, I didn't mean to spy...
No, it's fine.\nSinging is my livelihood —\nnothing to be embarrassed about being seen.
Right, you're a singer, Tsubasa.\nYou're really good.
Thanks.\nI can't get proper lessons right now,\nso I want to practice even a little.
A student and a singer, and fighting Noise...\nthat's admirable.
Not really,\nI'm just doing\nwhat I can...
Besides, singing isn't a burden.\nIt's my bond.
With Kanade...\nand with Hibiki, my comrades, the audience...\neveryone who supports me.
I want to end this fight soon,\nstand on stage again,\nand sing before an audience.
That comfort that fills my whole body\ncan only be felt there...
(Tsubasa on stage...)
Something wrong?
I was thinking\nhow cool you must look on stage.
Thanks.\nEven as flattery, that makes me happy.
I was thinking\nhow beautiful you must look on stage.
H-huh, sorry.\nDid I say something weird?\nI just really think you'd look beautiful.
No, I'm just not used to a man saying that to my face.\nIt surprised me.
Really?\nI figured you heard it all the time.\nYou're beautiful, Tsubasa.
C-could you not repeat it so much...?
But hearing that,\nI feel even more motivated to take the stage.
Until then, I'll listen anytime, if you'll have me.
...Thank you.
Maybe it's 'cause I got to talk with you.\nI feel like I'll sleep well tonight.
Well then, I'm heading back.\nGood night.
...Fuu.
I'll stop here for today.\nSorry for making you sit through practice.
...You're frozen. What's wrong?
I couldn't help trembling...\nhearing it up close, a singer's voice is incredible.
Fufu, thanks.\nI'm happy I got to sing full-out after so long.
After all, a song only lives\nwhen someone hears it.
When all I do is fight,\nI tend to forget —\nbut I am a singer too.
I almost feel bad\nhogging this all to myself.
It's fine —\nhaving a listener stimulates me too.
In return, if I may —\ncan I ask your impressions?
Don't hold back.\nThere must be something — something I could do better.
Put like that... hmm...\nSomething does nag at me.
Oh? What is it?
N-no complaints!\nIt's just...\nsomething that might make it even better.
Now I'm curious... please tell me.
If it's hard to put into words,\ntake your time thinking.
(Hmm, what is this nagging feeling.\nStaaare...)
A-awawa, sorry!\nUm...
It was nothing after all. Forget it.
No!\nThen I'll be up all night wondering.
Until you remember,\nyou're stuck with me today.
Whaaat!?
Did you cut your hair?
...Huh?
Ah, I meant it as a joke\nabout noticing small changes...
A j-joke?
Don't mess around,\nI'm asking seriously!
Eek, sorry!
...I'm sorry.\nI got carried away.
But whatever your opinion is,\nI'll take it seriously.
That dissonance you felt —\nI'd be glad if you told me next time.
Yes, I'll think about it too.
Tsubasa!
That look...\nCould it be about the other day?
Yes, I figured out what was nagging me.
I've been waiting.\nSince then, I just can't\nconcentrate on singing.
Now, tell me.\nIt's fine, I'm prepared.
Before that...\ncould I hear you sing once more?
...Understood.
...Just as I thought.
Now, will you tell me?\nWhat was wrong.
...What's wrong?\nWhy won't you tell me?
Is your silence the answer?\nThat it's not worth answering...?
No, it's not that.\nIt's just... whether I should say this...
No need to hesitate.\nI'll lend an ear to any harsh words.
Kazanari Tsubasa's convictions aren't so fragile\nthey'd waver from that.
...Understood. Then I'll tell you.
Your singing isn't bad — it's perfect.\nThere's nothing wrong with it.
What do you mean?\nThen what is it...
It's BECAUSE it's perfect!\nThere's something missing!
Wh-what is it!?
In short, it's this...
As a woman, as a singer —\nyou have no openings!
N-no openings...!?\nIsn't that a good thing?
I've always disciplined myself and pursued perfection,\nso as to be beyond reproach...
As a warrior, sure...\nBut as a woman?
A-as a woman...?\nP-put that way...
A perfect woman is hard to approach.\nBut openings create familiarity,\nand that leads to affection.
Openings create familiarity...\nSo that's how it works...
I-I see...\nSo that's why Tachibana\ngets along with everyone...
Come to think of it, Kanade too...
Um, Tsubasa?
...\nI'm fine.\nYour advice pierced my heart without mercy.
What I was missing...\nI understand now...
Thank you.\nI never would've reached\nthat answer alone.
Glad I could help.\nI'm one of your fans, after all.
Yes, truly.\nI can't thank you enough\nfor showing me a new possibility.
Maybe I overstepped...\nIt's just an amateur's opinion,\nso don't take it too seriously.
You listened to my singing seriously.\nThat's exactly why\nI'll listen to your opinion.
From now on, I — Kazanari Tsubasa —\nwill retrain myself,\nto be reborn...
I'll take my leave for today...
(I passed on the advice J gave me,\nbut... was that really okay...)
S-sorry I'm late.
It's fine. But YOU'RE...
Yes, me being late\nis unusual, isn't it?
Fufu, it is.\nI accidentally overslept...
Um, it's night right now...
Well then,\nyou'll sit through singing practice with me again today.
(She dodged that...\nTsubasa seems different today, somehow...?)
Whew, that was sloppy.
*Clap clap clap*! Th-that was amazing!
But it felt different from usual —\nisn't this that Japanese thing called 'enka'?
Oh, you know about it.
It's a different style from usual...\nI thought it might be nice\nfor a change...
How am I today?
As skilled as ever.\nCool enough to make me swoon.
As ever...?
You seem kinda cute today.
C-cute...\n?\nYou mean I'm full of openings and easy to close in on?
Huh?\nWell, you're still hard to approach...
Still hard to approach...?
Th-that can't be!\nI'm exposing myself\nso defenselessly!
Even just now,\nI got the lyrics wrong in three places!
Huh?
...Then how about this!
Ah, I dropped the mic!\nI might be cuuursed~.
...Wait, I was singing unmic'd...
Kuh...!
No good, I can't do this!\nThis is just embarrassing myself!
Eeeeeh!?
What on earth happened to you, Tsubasa...
You came.\nI owe you an apology.
The other day, well, I'm sorry.\nI must have confused you.
N-no, I was just a little surprised.
Taking your advice,\nI tried my own way\nto seem more approachable...
The result was as you saw.\nA miserable clown.
I shouldn't try things I can't do.\nI've learned my limits\nto a sickening degree.
(Isn't Tsubasa taking this too hard!?\nI gotta say something...)
That's not true!\nYou were cute then too?
Even such comforting words\nfeel good to me now...
(Did that backfire!?\nShe's that depressed...)
As you know,\nmy poor social skills are certified.
I tried to change that about myself,\nbut... it seems\nit's beyond me...
This might be the first time\nI've lost this much confidence...\nPathetic, even to myself.
No way... Giving up just isn't like you, Tsubasa!
Huh...?
You'd encourage even someone like me...?\nYou...
But what should I do?\nEven I don't want to end up\nas a half-baked Kazanari Tsubasa.
You don't have to force yourself.\nThe way you're a little hard to approach,\nyour earnestness, your nobility — those are real charms of yours.
But if you just... reach out to everyone a little,\nmaybe something will change?
If I do that, I can get closer\nto the ideal version of myself...?
Reaching out from my side, huh...\nMaybe I really was the one building those walls.
(Did I get through to her...?)
You always give me courage, don't you.
Why do you try so hard for me?\nWhy take me so seriously?
No, you don't have to say it.\nI can tell well enough myself...
To live up to your feelings,\nI need to shed this old skin of mine.
Tsubasa...?
The final battle... yes, at that place.
(That place...?)
Huh? What's this?
It's a discount voucher for a concert ticket.\nYou said you wanted to see\nmy performance.
Can I really take this?
Of course.\nConsider it thanks for listening\nto all my troubles.
On that stage,\nI'll show you a new me,\nand practice even harder.
Th-That's something to look forward to.
Thanks for everything.\nWell then.
So 'that place'\nmeant the stage...\nVery Tsubasa, I guess...
